Originally settled by Gaelic Irish, it experienced centuries of conflict and colonization, notably the 17th-century Plantation of Ulster with Protestant settlers. This led to ongoing tensions, culminating in partition in 1921, creating a region with a majority Protestant, unionist population desiring to remain within the UK. The subsequent decades saw significant unrest known as “The Troubles,” addressed by the 1998 Good Friday Agreement, though sectarianism persists. Today, Northern Ireland blends Irish and British cultures, with a growing economy and a unique identity, offering visitors a fascinating and historically rich experience.capital:Belfastpopulation:1,903,200area:14,130 km²Data sourcesAdd photoOther links:en.wikipedia.orgGPS54.5963908N, 5.9301831W`CopyWGS84 (degrees) 31. 3. 2026With Mapy.com Premium, you can now organize your saved points and routes in the My Mapy section into subfolders.
